bosses.name: Yamaraja: Stone, Badger Devil
bosses.strategy:
Note that Yamaraja: Stone is actually a FIRE class, so Man Dragon will be
your go-to Fusion if you're taking the magic route.
Other than the fact that he uses defensive spells (that don't seem to
help him at all), all he'll use are physical attacks. They're not TOO
strong, but if he focuses on just one person on two different attacks,
he'll whittle their HP down quicker than you realize, so stay healed.
Have Yuri either fuse into the Man Dragon and blast him continuously with
Flash Flood, or just fuse into the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting
Spirit) and hammer away at him with physical attacks. Zhuzhen should be
continually casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should use Aqua Edge on
Yuri first (if he's attacking), then have her use Snipe continuously.
Zhuzhen will probably be doing the least amount of damage, so have him on
healing duty when HP starts to drop. This Yamaraja is fairly easy
compared to the last two bosses.

bosses.name: Dehuai
bosses.strategy:
Another Fire-based boss? Don't mind if I do! Makes Margarete that much
more useful!
Dehuai's fire attacks, Magnard and Blaze, will hit your whole party for
decent damage, and he also has a rather quick (and interestingly bizarre)
physical attack that also does decent to major damage. He also has a Fast
Ring attack that hits for decent damage, and it can possibly make your
Judgment Ring spin faster. Make sure to keep healed and try to keep that
Ring status off!
Have Yuri either fuse into the Man Dragon and blast him continuously with
Flash Flood, or just fuse into the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting
Spirit) and hammer away at him with physical attacks. Zhuzhen should be
continually casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should use Aqua Edge on
Yuri first (if he's attacking), then have her use Snipe continuously.
Zhuzhen will probably be doing the least amount of damage, so have him on
healing duty when HP starts to drop. He's pretty easy as well, but the
challenge is upcoming.

bosses.name: Yamaraja: Calamity
bosses.strategy:
Yamaraja will most likely start off with the Crimson Flame spell, dealing
MAJOR fire damage to your party and possibly Silencing them as well. His
Petrification attack should only do medium damage to your party IF you're
protected against it; otherwise, you'll turn to stone, and three
Petrified party members equals a game over. He'll also use a Shockwave
attack, but it only does a small amount of damage to your whole party.
His physical attacks are nothing to sneeze at either; a series of three
attacks will do MAJOR damage to a party member.
As much as I hate to say this, Yuri will need to be the primary healer of
this battle, as he's the only one that has a heal-all spell, and without
it, it will be hard to keep up with the healing with just two party
members. Fuse him into the Heaven's Fiend, then cast Sacred Remedy if
your party needs healing, and if they don't, then use Exorcist Arrow.
Zhuzhen should be constantly casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should be
using Snipe. When the party's MP starts getting low, have Margarete use
Mana Seeds to boost them back up.
Due to the sheer amount of HP Yamaraja has, and the fact that your main
damage dealer is on healing duty, prepare for a very long battle. You'll
most likely need to use at least two Pure Seeds to keep Zhuzhen's and
Margarete's SP up.

notes.text: If you're still in need of Cash at this point, the Pure Extract sells for 10,000 Cash. Just sayin'.

This is your point of no return. If there's ANYTHING else you wish to do in Asia, now's the time. Once you proceed with the next battle, you won't be able to go back. Also, make sure that you have fought all four Evil enemies in the Graveyard for your Monster Library.
Just to let you know, two of your party members will be temporarily leaving after these events, but not to worry; their accessories will automatically be put back into your inventory, so no worries.

Before climbing the stairs, open the visible chest on the stairs to the left
for a [_SEAL OF LIFE_], then open the second not-so-visible chest on the
opposite side for a [_THIRD KEY_]. If you wanted to buy something but was short
on cash, you now have an extra 15,000+ Cash available if you sell this, once
again.

Once you have both of those, start climbing the central staircase and attempt
to enter the Yawang Gate, where you'll have to take on another Yamaraja!

After the battle, you'll receive the [_B. TORTOISE VP_], and you'll
automatically enter the Tower. On the center platform is a Save Point, so be
sure to use it. You should see a chest directly beside the Save Point, but on
the other side, so run clockwise until you reach the chest containing a
[_LOTTERY TICKET_]. From the remaining two staircases here, go up the eastern
one, following the path to the next area.
Up on the next floor, examine the area just to the upper-left of the stairs,
where you'll find a place to insert the B. Tortoise VP. Choose to put it in,
then choose "the Black Tortoise" to place the picture in its place. After doing
that, check the far left side of the room to find a [_PURE EXTRACT_], then
enter the newly unlocked door on the right side of the room. Out here, follow
the path to the next area, then at the end of the path, open the chest for a
[_B. DRAGON VP_]. Once you have it, head back down to the first area with the
Save Point.

  NOTE     If you're still in need of Cash at this point, the Pure Extract
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   sells for 10,000 Cash. Just sayin'.

From the Save Point, stay on the platform you're currently on and take the
northwestern path to the next area. Go to the left side of the room and look on
the ground beneath the artwork to find an.... [_EROTIC BOOK_]. Oh LàLà...?
OH LÀLÀ?!?! ( For all of you Back to the Future nuts like me. ;D ) It's a copy
of "Shanghai Angels"... Make sure to grab this, as it'll come in very handy
much later in the game. If you don't grab it, you'll definitely regret it.

In any case, while you're here, make sure examine the altar in the right-center
of the room to find a votive picture. Choose to take it, and you'll receive the
[_R. PHOENIX VP_]. Re-examine the altar here and choose to insert "the Blue
Dragon" into its place. Make your way back to the Save Point.

Take the last path that we haven't taken yet: the western staircase. Once
you're on the next floor up, examine the altar above you and choose to insert
"the Red Phoenix" into the hole there. Ignore the locked gate to your east for
now, and enter the newly unlocked door to the next area. Open the chest here
for the [_W. TIGER VP_], and since we're now at a dead-end, make your way back
to the Save Point.

Take the path northwest of the Save Point once again to the room where we found
the Erotic Book. Choose to take out the B. Dragon VP and replace it with "the
White Tiger" to have the correct one in its place. Make your way back to the
Save Point for the last time. Examine the altar here in the center of the room
and choose to insert "the Blue Dragon" to solve the puzzle here.

Make your way back up the western stairs, and go through the door you unlocked.
There is now a Save Point here; prepare for a battle, and Save. When you're
ready, go up the stairs on the right to the next area for a scene. Just a bit
after, you'll have a sub-boss battle.

     / * SUB-BOSS * \

|                                                                             |
|  The Badger Devil uses a Fire Ball attack that doesn't hit for much damage  |
|  at all, and a physical attack that hits for a slightly decent amount.      |
|  Either way, it's not much to worry about.                                  |
|                                                                             |
|  The Badger Devil is susceptible to Instant Death, so do one of the         |
|  following two things:                                                      |
|                                                                             |
|  1) Fuse Yuri into the Death Emperor and cast Dark Messenger. Make sure to  |
|     hit the small red "Perfect!!" area, and voilà! Dead-dead-deadski.       |
|                                                                             |
|  2) Have Margarete use her Snipe ability. Make sure to hit the small red    |
|     "Perfect!!" area, and BAM!!! History.                                   |
|                                                                             |
|  If you're lucky, one of the first two steps will kill it. Sadly, it        |
|  doesn't ALWAYS work.                                                       |
|                                                                             |
|  If you don't have luck with either of those, no worries; he's still easy.  |
|  Have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting Spirit)     |
|  and hammer away at him with physical attacks. Zhuzhen should be            |
|  continually casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should use Aqua Edge on     |
|  Yuri first, then have her use Snipe continuously. He'll fall quickly.      |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   01000 EXP   / \   00600 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

After the battle, check just to your right near the glowing light for a
[_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Continue southeast to open the door here, which is the
locked door near the eastern stairs from earlier. Also, descend the stairs just
below where you entered, and you'll find the chest behind the gate that we
ignored earlier. Open it for a [_TALISMANOFWISDOM_]. Once you have that, make
your way back to the last Save Point and SAVE YOUR GAME.

  NOTE     This is your point of no return. If there's ANYTHING else you wish
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   to do in Asia, now's the time. Once you proceed with the next
           battle, you won't be able to go back. Also, make sure that you have
           fought all four Evil enemies in the Graveyard for your
           Monster Library.

When you're absolutely ready, go back to where you fought the Badger Devil and
climb the steps to the west. Watch the events unfold, then take on Dehuai
himself.

After the battle and series of events, you'll regain control, and you'll get to
choose your party. I recommend keeping your current party of Yuri, Zhuzhen, and
Margarete, as Alice won't be of much help in the next boss battle. Make sure to
equip the Hermit's Staff on Zhuzhen that you won in the last battle. When you
regain control, head back down to the previous floor and SAVE YOUR GAME.

Once you've saved, go back to the upper floor and talk to the Japanese soldier
on the left. He will offer to change your party, in case you've changed your
mind, but if you choose to not change it, then you'll also find out that he's a
Lottery Member!

The ring here moves fast, so remember, equipping the Pocket Watch will make it
easier to hit the areas! Make sure to win the Warlock Earrings before
continuing on; it increases your S-Atk up 20%, but will also increase the
damage received from S-Atks by 20%! If you don't win it, reload your last save
and try again. Remember, you need to win something from each member at least
once!

The Japanese Soldier to the right has items for sale. The next boss uses both
Petrification and Silence, so either equip Zodiac and Cosmic Bracelets on
everyone, or buy three each of the Bell Bracelets and Mirror Bracelets that
this guy has for sale, as well as any healing items you may need.
